product.title: Evac+Chair 750H Evacuation Stair Chair
product.body_html:
The Evac+Chair 750H evacuation chair is capable of various forms of evacuation. Suitable for 1 or 2 person operation. Evac-Trac belts give the user ultimate control descending evacuation and features carry handles enabling the chair to be carried upstairs.

  • Head support with padded cushion - Headrest with padded cushion for comfortably securing the passenger in place
  • Anti-slip height adjustable handle - For ease of deployment, operation and compact storage
  • Additional operator handles - For added stability when employing additional operators
  • Quick release 4-point harness - 4 point harness for increased passenger welfare
  • High strength aluminum frame - Increased strength and robustness for continued use
  • Way-finding decals - For easy location in emergency situations
  • Adjustable self braking Evac+Tracs - Reinforced adjustable tracks control speed of descent on all types of stairways
  • Industrial locking rear wheels - For application in situations where the chair needs stay in a stationary position
  • Includes: User Guide, Cushioned Head Support Headrest, 4 Point Passenger Harness, Photoluminescent Wall Sign, Wall Hook, Dust Cover, Manufacturer's Warranty
  • Folded Dimensions: Height 43.3", Width 22.4", Depth 10.4", Weight 41 lbs, Weight Capacity 500 lbs
  • Simple to operate
  • Single person operation in descent
  • Easy to open, ready to operate in seconds
  • Robust and compact in size
  • Lightweight construction
  • Provides a rapid solution for safe emergency evacuation
  • Minimal moving and handling required
  • Allows small operators to transport passengers larger than their size
  • Foldable for easy storage
  • Wall mountable


About Evac+Chair of North America
EVAC+CHAIR is the original Emergency Evacuation Staircase Chair. It is simple to use, lightweight and easy to deploy and maneuver. Emergency evacuation equipment and stair transport chairs are critical in emergency situations for people with disabilities. Wall-mounted and discreet, evacuation chairs are ideal for use in office buildings, hotels, hospitals, skyscrapers and high-rise buildings. Ask about their lifetime warranty.
